alt: Real ChatGPT /crossword execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /crossword Using only the attached chapter, create an interactive mini crossword with training, inference and context. Include clue fields, hints, answer checking and a visible letter grid. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

phases.name: upload
phases.caption: Open a new temporary chat and upload the chapter PDF.

phases.name: setup-generation
phases.caption: ChatGPT reads the uploaded chapter · accelerated.

phases.name: typing
phases.caption: Write the shortcut request as the second message.

phases.name: send
phases.caption: Send the shortcut as the second message.

phases.name: widget
phases.caption: Inspect the generated widget before using its controls.

phases.name: usage
phases.caption: Use the widget at normal speed.

actions.label: Ask for a hint on the first clue.
Check the attempt and inspect the feedback.
Correct the first word to inference.
Complete the second clue with training.
Complete the last clue with context.
Inspect the filled grid and its 3/3 result.
Reset the puzzle and clear the grid.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
